decisions.summary: Every painter grows its shape by one cell
decisions.why: The rules hold by construction; a placement lost at a margin is a map change the GM allowed (2026-09-30).

decisions.summary: Regions built per consumer window, never the canvas
decisions.why: A cost choice inside FR-001/FR-004; the region is still computed once per consumer.

decisions.summary: Every offerer (front row, lattice, rescue cloud, exhaustive pass) offers only seats the region admits, computed per round's candidate list at once
decisions.why: FR-001: seats offered only from the region, every round, the exhaustive pass included.

decisions.summary: Buildable raster admits a seat where at least one garden side's envelope (smallest house, household-independent template, turn 0) is clear
decisions.why: Round 1 item 1 addressed: the test is now the envelope FR-001 names. The smallest house was accepted in round 1; testing at turn 0 is an approximation of where an envelope can stand inside the conservative margin, and the placer still decides the turned seat - a calibration of the region, not a carve-out of it.

decisions.summary: Reachable raster: free buildable cells flood-filled from the tree, redone on each corridor or seated house; the door ground must touch it
decisions.why: Round 1 item 2 addressed: the region now carries reach to the access tree on free ground (FR-001, the GM's 'reachable and buildable'); the exact corridor stays the placer's (C).

decisions.summary: Marsh array throws against one KeepoutGrid that now files the crescent ponds and the pond ellipse (with pad and blade tip), plus the drawn ground's RingIndex, read once for all points
decisions.why: Round 1 item 3 addressed: no keep-out is asked per point or in turn (FR-004, US3); the outline inside-test was accepted in round 1.

decisions.summary: Marsh marks land at different random places at the same densities
decisions.why: The GM allowed map changes (2026-09-30); densities held per FR-004.

decisions.summary: Grove static keep-outs painted into a Region; candidates via taken_many; static_clear itself backed by the region for every caller (grid, windbreak gap fill, re-seat); spacing per survivor
decisions.why: Round 1 item 7 addressed; FR-004 as written, spacing being the per-glyph exception FR-004 allows.

decisions.summary: Woodland search: one Region per half, box_clear per square
decisions.why: FR-004 as written.

decisions.summary: Before _bundle_geom is called: field reach, water (lot.watered), house box, seat_reaches_tree on the core geometry from the household template; the four layouts share the answers
decisions.why: Round 1 item 4 addressed: the water is among the seat's questions and the corridor test needs no built layout (FR-002). The per-household template is not a per-seat layout.

decisions.summary: The bundle template is keyed per household, not per offered seat
decisions.why: Serves FR-002 and SC-002's layouts count; the maps it moves are allowed.

decisions.summary: LaneLaw keeps per-lane and joint verdicts, judged on every write
decisions.why: FR-005: verdicts kept from the moment a lane is laid.

decisions.summary: Network-wide rules (networks count, fragments, reach, needle loops, way outs) asked once at the end on a version stamp
decisions.why: Unchanged from round 1: a web is fragmentary while it is laid, so admitting each write against these is physically impossible. The condition holds: D4 now states a break found at the end raises WebRefused and nothing is repaired or dropped there.

decisions.summary: The access tree's lanes drawn at the start of stage_web
decisions.why: FR-005 lists the access tree's lanes among those admitted as laid.

decisions.summary: Each rule's repair applied by the write hook to the lane named, its own writes judged at their write; a lane no repair makes lawful is not laid (never a tree lane)
decisions.why: Round 1 item 5 addressed: FR-005 says a lane that would break a rule is reshaped or not laid at that moment; no round follows.

decisions.summary: The settle's rounds, unsettled and the last resort retired; stage end reads the keeper and refuses by name; an unworkable mechanism is withdrawn by reviewed amendment, never kept as an exception
decisions.why: Round 1 item 6 addressed: the 'recorded in dev/performance.md' escape is gone; FR-005 and SC-005 as written.

decisions.summary: Mats as a computed centered lattice per gap over the floor grid
decisions.why: FR-003 as written.

decisions.summary: Hit regions, explanations and the blob computed while the picture and id map render
decisions.why: FR-006 as written.

decisions.summary: The hem's box prefilter around the collector
decisions.why: FR-007 as written.

decisions.summary: A lever slower or failing the gate after fixes is withdrawn by a spec amendment; D3 and D4 land together
decisions.why: Routes through a reviewed amendment, so it narrows nothing without review.

decisions.summary: T11 and T16 record each moved map's houses, paddies and ways before and after; T16 runs the cohort
decisions.why: Round 1 tasks item addressed: SC-009's before/after record is a task.
